summary: Reader is a web application and library designed for processing web feeds. Built entirely using pure Python and standard library components, it provides a straightforward codebase that you can deploy as a standalone service or embed directly into other Python projects.
goodFor: Python developers who want a lightweight feed processing tool with minimal external dependencies or who wish to integrate feed parsing and management into custom applications.
watchOut: The project relies on a niche pure-Python stack, meaning you may encounter fewer community resources, themes, or third-party integrations compared to more mainstream feed readers.
deployNotes: As a Python web application, you will typically run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and manage it with a process manager like systemd or within a container.
